punchline: When your mind says you're finished, David Goggins says you've likely used only about 40 percent of what you have.
thirty_sec: In Can't Hurt Me, ultramarathoner and former SEAL David Goggins describes his 40% Rule: when your mind says you're done, you're really only about 40 percent done. It's a rule of thumb, not science. To keep going, he uses a 'Cookie Jar' of past victories, and 'calluses' his mind by doing hard things on purpose. It's about mental barriers, not ignoring real injury.
question: Where did you last quit at your very first 'I'm done'?
